name: io.github.founderie-labs/discord-mcp
description: Set up, monitor and manage one Discord server: channels, forums, roles, members, moderation.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token)

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_AUDIT_CHANNEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Private channel where every change is logged (recommended)

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_PROTECTED_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Channel, role or member IDs the admin tools must never change (recommended: your user ID and top role)
